picks.question: Will the UK’s 2026 inflation be between 3.5% and 3.9%?
picks.why: Where UK inflation lands in 2026 shapes Bank of England rate decisions and shows how persistent post-pandemic price pressures remain.

picks.question: Will real GDP increase by more than 2.0% in Q3 2026?
picks.why: Third-quarter growth above 2% would signal the U.S. economy is holding up despite tariffs and still-elevated interest rates.

picks.question: Will China’s 2026 annual GDP growth (Y/Y) be between 4.0% and 5.0%?
picks.why: China's growth rate drives global commodity demand and trade flows, and shows whether Beijing can meet its targets amid structural headwinds.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership in frontier AI models shapes where investment, talent, and productivity gains concentrate across the technology sector.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2026?
picks.why: An AI solving a Millennium Prize problem would mark a major step toward machines driving original scientific discovery.

picks.question: Clarity Act (H.R.3633) signed into law in 2026?
picks.why: The Clarity Act would set federal rules for crypto markets, affecting financial regulation, investor protection, and digital-asset capital flows.
